note: Recast from entry 372 of Fauna Sinica: Insecta, Volume 17, Isoptera (Pericapritermes fuscotibialis (Light), 1931); the original is in Chinese and describes only the alate (with an alate measurement table and fig. 447), the soldier and worker being left undescribed. The synonymy list (Capritermes fuscotibialis Light, 1931 and others), the literature citations and the figure numbers are not transcribed. In the measurement table the rows “head width including eyes”, “head width excluding eyes” and “pronotum width” run together in the OCR (which of 0.88, 0.95 and 0.62 belongs to which is uncertain), so only the unambiguous values are entered here and the value 0.62 is omitted. The copyright page is not visible in the OCR, so no publication year is cited.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate postclypeus slightly paler than the frons but distinctly brown, the sclerotised parts generally dark brown; compound eyes small, strongly projecting; ocelli small and narrowly elongate, more than twice as long as wide, the distance to the compound eye about equal to the ocellus length; antenna 14 segments, segment 3 very short; fontanelle slightly raised, white, behind the mid-point of the head; anterior margin of the pronotum straight, not raised in the middle, with a broad, extremely faint Y-shaped mark; tibiae darker than the femora and tarsi. Total length 11.50 mm, body length without wings 5.70 mm, total head length 1.35 mm, head width including eyes 1.15 mm, excluding eyes 0.88 mm. The original records the soldier and worker as unknown.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Postclypeus slightly paler than the frons but distinctly brown, the general colour of the sclerotised parts dark brown. Compound eyes small, strongly projecting. Ocelli small, narrowly elongate, facing anteromedially, more than twice as long as wide, the distance to the compound eye equal to the ocellus length. Antenna dark brown, 14 segments, segment 3 very short, segments 4 and 5 equal, segment 2 longer than segment 4 or 6, equal to segment 7. The head is highest at the level of the ocelli, lower in front and behind. Fontanelle slightly raised, white, behind the mid-point of the head. Anteclypeus white, postclypeus brown, its length much less than half its width, labrum very flat and yellow. Anterior margin of the pronotum straight, not raised in the middle, lateral margins projecting, with a broad, extremely faint Y-shaped mark that is not conspicuous. Anterior part of the mesonotum and metanotum yellow, the middle very pale smoky brown, the forked posterior part with a faint smoky patch on each side, the tips paler. Tibiae darker than the femora and tarsi. Wings brown with dense dots, the anterior margin with many hairs, the posterior margin with a row of hairs; costa thick, dark at the base and paler at the apex; the wing surface between the costa and the radial sector pale; radial sector thick and dark, surrounded by a very narrow bright area, separated in front by a very narrow dark line and behind by a broad yellow band; the other veins narrow and dark brown; media close to the cubitus; the forewing with 1 and the hindwing with 2 apical branches; cubitus with about 8 branches, the basal 3—4 thick. All parts densely hairy. Measurements: total length 11.50 mm; body length without wings 5.70 mm; total head length 1.35 mm; head length to the postclypeus 0.81 mm; head width including eyes 1.15 mm; head width excluding eyes 0.88 mm; fontanelle length 0.095 mm, width 0.068 mm; ocellus length 0.0135 mm, width 0.0054 mm; postclypeus width 0.54 mm, length 0.174 mm; pronotum width 0.95 mm. Distribution: Hong Kong.
